Definition: A control that does something when a person presses it, by clicking, tapping, or pressing Space or Enter.
To use a button: click it, tap it, or give it the focus and press Space or Enter.
The text on a button. It is also what a screen reader says when the button has the focus.
Extra text that a screen reader can read to explain what a control does.
The control that keyboard input goes to right now.
A button that shows an image instead of text. It still needs a name.
